Our story and purpose

Poverty is more than a lack of money.

As the world changes, communities continue to face challenges that affect health, education, safety and opportunity. Poverty can make it harder for individuals and families to access essential services and build stable futures.

WLAPO was conceived around a simple belief: a better world is possible when people work together to support vulnerable communities, share reliable information and create pathways to opportunity.

Our approach is grounded in compassion, respect, accountability and the understanding that lasting progress must respond to the needs of the people it serves.

Our vision

A world where no community is left behind.

Communities where people have practical opportunities to improve their wellbeing, develop skills and build sustainable livelihoods.

WLAPO campaign focus

Children of Latvia

Every child deserves a chance to thrive.

A proposed humanitarian campaign

Helping children access the foundations they need to grow.

Through the Children of Latvia Campaign, WLAPO proposes to focus on practical support for children and families facing hardship, with attention to education, nutrition, healthcare and essential livelihood needs.

The campaign concept was inspired by an appeal shared with WLAPO. That appeal is a starting point for listening and further assessment, not proof that every child or family in Latvia experiences the same circumstances.

Ongoing campaign

Our responsibility begins with listening.

WLAPO will publicly share activities, funding commitments and verified needs with local organisations and community partners. There will be clear definition of who the programme can serve, and arrangements for delivering and reporting support.

Confirmed programme details and progress updates will be shared, and results, partnerships, or services will be claimed based on verification.

Our guiding belief: a child's circumstances should not determine the opportunities available to them.

Proposed support priorities

Four foundations for child wellbeing.

These are the campaign's proposed areas of focus, subject to local needs assessment and responsible implementation.

🎓

Educational support

Learning materials, educational resources and practical assistance that can help children participate in learning.

🥗

Nutritional support

Support pathways that improve access to nutritious food and essential food supplies for children and families.

💚

Healthcare support

Help connecting children and families with appropriate primary healthcare, preventive services and health information.

🏠

Essential livelihood support

Basic-needs assistance for vulnerable households, with the aim of supporting children's safety, stability and dignity.

WLAPO — Children of Latvia

Our net donation target

€27,000

Proposed fundraising goal

Together, our goal is to raise €25,000 in net donations to support vulnerable children across Latvia, bringing hope, opportunity and a better future to those who need it most.

Proposed allocation of the target

A provisional planning breakdown of how the €27,000 net target could be directed:

Educational assistance€7,000
Food and basic necessities€8,000
Children's health and wellbeing€5,000
Clothing and essential supplies€4,000
Emergency family support€3,000
Total proposed allocation€27,000

What “net donations” means: the amount WLAPO actually receives after payment-processing fees and other applicable deductions.

Accountability commitment: WLAPO will not publish unverified needs figures or promise services that have not been arranged. Programme activities, partners, fundraising targets and outcomes will be shared only when confirmed.
